name: Motion Master
description: Canonical Motion Master motion, palette and typography tokens. This file is the single source of truth: the MCP server, the skills and the Montage bridge all read it. Do not duplicate these values by hand.

paletteUsage.accentBudget: Accent is a mark, not a decoration: CTA and emphasis only, at most 8% of any viewport. Never a background or border fill.
paletteUsage.accentText: #FF4A1C on #F4F4F2 is about 3.3:1 — large text and non-text only. Small text uses ink or accentDark (#D63A12).

entrance.name: emphasized
entrance.note: Anything entering the frame decelerates. This is the Motion Master entrance curve.

exit.name: accelerate
exit.note: Anything leaving the frame accelerates away. Exit is 65-75% of the matching entrance duration.

onScreen.name: standard
onScreen.note: Anything that stays on screen and changes state uses the symmetric curve.

linear.name: linear
linear.note: Progress bars, counters, anything the viewer must read as a measurement.

noBounce.note: Critical damping for premium work: no overshoot, no bounce.

stagger.rule: Total stagger MUST stay under 500ms. When a group is too large, shorten the interval rather than exceed the budget.

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion, freeze on the final frame, drop reveals, keep state changes instant and legible.

antiSlop: No violet, indigo or purple — anywhere, including gradients.
No rounded-rectangle card grids as a default container.
No glowing blobs, floating orbs or abstract gradient backgrounds.
No three identical feature cards, no default bento grid.
No decorative serif or italic word swap in a headline.
No cream, ivory, clay, olive or terracotta palette.
No fake browser chrome, fake testimonials, fake logos or fake numbers.
Banned words: transform, unlock, empower, reimagine, revolutionize, supercharge, seamless, elevate, game-changing.
No 'Get Started' as a call to action.
